newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat down in good trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat down in good trade.

text.p: Argentine cash new crop wheat slipped in good volume trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with producers unsure how far values will go down and trying to fix prices now, traders said.

The market has recently become more slightly more optimistic about the size of Argentina's wheat crop, now seen by many as hitting 15 million tonnes. Cash new crop soybeans also fell, dragged down by a lower Chicago, in brisk turnover. March sunflower seed sagged after sunflower seed, also in good volume. New crop maize rose, with exporters retaking positions they had earlier sold, at a good profit. Volume was hearty.
